gloss: policy interest rate; the benchmark interest rate set by a central bank to guide monetary policy

definitions.gloss: policy interest rate; the benchmark interest rate set by a central bank to guide monetary policy
definitions.explanation: Used in economics and finance contexts. In Japan, this refers to the rate set by the Bank of Japan.

examples.japanese: {政策金利|せいさくきんり}が{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げられた。
examples.english: The policy interest rate was raised.

examples.japanese: {日本銀行|にほんぎんこう}は{政策金利|せいさくきんり}を{据|す}え{置|お}きにした。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan kept the policy interest rate unchanged.

examples.japanese: {政策金利|せいさくきんり}の{変更|へんこう}は{住宅|じゅうたく}ローンの{金利|きんり}にも{影響|えいきょう}を{与|あた}える。
examples.english: Changes in the policy interest rate also affect mortgage interest rates.

notes:
A compound of {政策|せいさく} (policy) and {金利|きんり} (interest rate). This is the interest rate that a country's central bank sets as a primary tool for monetary policy, influencing lending rates, inflation, and economic activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}を{引|ひ}き{上|あ}げる: to raise the policy rate
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}を{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げる: to lower the policy rate
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}を{据|す}え{置|お}く: to hold the policy rate steady
- {政策金利|せいさくきんり}の{決定|けってい}: policy rate decision

RELATED TERMS:
- {金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}: monetary easing
- {金融引き締め|きんゆうひきしめ}: monetary tightening
- {利上|りあ}げ: rate hike
- {利下|りさ}げ: rate cut
- ゼロ{金利|きんり}{政策|せいさく}: zero interest rate policy
